definition: to ask loudly for something you need
description: On an outdoor basketball court with a blue surface and a green metal fence at dusk, a young man in a blue sleeveless top and black shorts, seen from behind, holds the ball above his head. A young woman with long curly hair, in a red crop top and black shorts, stretches one arm high with her mouth open, shouting for the ball. She then runs up close to him and raises both arms high while he keeps the ball above his head. Two young men stand watching by the fence.
